headline: Peru approves S/1,500 bonus for 60,000 artisanal fishermen impacted by El Niño
summary: The government of Peru authorized direct emergency transfers of 1,500 soles ($395) for 60,000 small-scale fishermen affected by climate disturbances in coastal waters.
why: El Niño coastal warming periodically disrupts marine ecosystems and coastal fishing economic activity across Peru.
